title: Austin's Airport Land & Convention Center Plans
summary:
*   **Airport Land Acquisition Approved:** The city council formally approved a new process for acquiring land needed for the Austin City Airport.
*   **Convention Center Site Recommendation:** The Planning Commission presented its recommendation for an "east side site" as the preferred location for the future convention center.
*   **Legislative Briefing:** A legislative update was provided, informing attendees on current matters impacting the city.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL MEETING - March 28, 1989 - 2:00 P.M.
Council Chamber*, 307 Vdfcl Second Street, Amtin. TexM Mayor Pro Tern Shipman called to
